The Physics of Decompression Horror

On November 5, 1983, a catastrophic failure at the Byford Dolphin rig caused one of the most violent industrial accidents in history. How does rapid decompression affect human biology at a molecular level? 🤿🔬 Read on to uncover the science behind the tragedy. What do you think is the most dangerous aspect of deep-sea exploration?
